specs.title: add from product page, counter, panel rows, remove
quantity limits: 0→1, 100→99, decimals and letters revert
persists across pages and syncs across tabs
codes removed from the catalogue are dropped silently
e-mail link encodes line breaks as %0D%0A
works in memory when localStorage is blocked
quote buttons are hidden, content and contact links work
GA id empty (production build): no banner, no gtag, no cookie preferences link, policy says no analytics
desktop dropdown: click/keyboard open, Escape closes and returns focus
mobile menu opens with the menu button (popover) and closes with Escape
language switcher points to the same page in the other language
skip link is first in tab order and moves focus to main
thumbnails mark the current slide; lightbox keyboard navigation and focus return
single-image product shows no thumbnails or arrows
without JS, thumbnails are #g-N anchors and images link to full-size files
chips filter in place, use the URL hash and announce the count
without JS chips are links to category pages
mobile bar is 56-64 px + safe area, hidden on short (landscape) screens, never covers the footer
focused elements are not hidden under the sticky header or mobile bar (SC 2.4.11)
no request to Google before consent; banner is compact with equal buttons
accept loads gtag with consent defaults and tracks a WhatsApp click
reject: no Google request at all, even after reloads
withdrawing consent deletes _ga cookies and reloads
analytics does not run on another hostname (ANL-06)
storage blocked: the decision lasts for this page only
cookie policy lists _ga cookies in the GA build
KAL-15 with consent granted: no JS errors, no CSP violations, no 404s
